issues.description: The exercise text and UML refer to the same animal feeding behavior using two different method names. The UML and the solution implement an abstract method named messageOnFeed() (solution: src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java line 18). However, multiple places in the problem statement refer to getFeedingSound() (e.g. Seal/Pig/Goat tasks and the Farm.feedAllAnimals description). This mismatch (messageOnFeed() vs getFeedingSound()) can confuse students about which method to implement and which method Farm should call when printing feeding sounds.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across the problem statement and code. Prefer updating the problem_statement.md occurrences of getFeedingSound() to messageOnFeed() (to match the UML and the provided solution), or explicitly state that getFeedingSound() and messageOnFeed() are the same and choose one canonical API name. Update all task descriptions (Seal/Pig/Goat), the Farm.feedAllAnimals description, and any example lines in the spec to use the chosen name so students implement and call the correct method.
